events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 31 Dec 2026. Pre-season activities including social events to get to know each other, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and 1-2 adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season includes indoor training January, weekend practices February through May, weeknight and weekend rides March-May, and 5-6 NICA races across North Carolina starting in early March
